episodes.name: From the Village, To Girl Dad, Through Covid with Scott DeRosa
episodes.description:
On this episode of A Modern Man Podcast, I am joined by my friend Scott Derosa. Scott and I met playing volleyball this fall. He talks about his struggles growing up with a father of addiction in the panhandle of West Texas. He did not come from a diverse community, but the village that raised him taught him to love his neighbor regardless of who they are and what they look like. He then left the small town with big-city dreams just outside of Houston. He spent a few years there until he met his eventual wife. This led him to be a girl dad to 3 incredible young girls at such a young age. He made the commitment and moved to Oklahoma City in 2008, and he has been here ever since. After a decade of marriage, covid came. He thought he was changing careers and inevitably leaving Oklahoma, but the pandemic changed that. He was lucky enough to stay at his job for a few months longer than expected, but after that, he was unsure of his future. All he knows for sure is that he wants to be honest and respectful of everyone’s struggle and he understands we all need help sometimes.

episodes.name: EP. 15 | I’M DATING
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn steps into her dating era—on purpose.

No scripts. No shrinking. Just curiosity, discernment, and a running check-in with her nervous system.

She talks about dating multiple people for the first time and what it’s teaching her: that the “first-time” feelings we crown as fate are often just data. Calm after a date can feel like savasana—and it doesn’t make someone your soulmate. Chivalry (hello, car doors) is lovely, but it’s the baseline, not the banner.

Jenna shares why she asks big questions early (kids, money, marriage, values), why a non-negotiables list is clarity—not rigidity—and how to flip the focus from “Do they like me?” to “Do I like them?” She explores living your 20s with intention, taking aligned action, and letting people feel the weight of you—then decide.

There’s a real-life interruption (dog drama, ER and all), messy consistency, and a through-line of truth: don’t slip into a life; build one. Ask better questions. Make choices today your future will thank you for.

For feedback or thoughts, email Jenna at jenna.andrix@gmail.com

Host: Jenna Marilyn

Producer: JD Ferrell

Presented by: THE Modern Podcast Network and Themodern.fm

episodes.name: EP. 14 | MY(YOUR) REALITY
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn opens up about her evolving views on love and marriage — and why her opinion isn’t the point. What matters most is sharing a reality with your partner, finding someone whose vision of life aligns with yours.

She shares her new mantra and the pattern she’s noticed: every time she doesn’t get what she wants, she gets something better. With honesty and clarity, Jenna explores what it means to take aligned action through her superpower of discernment.


You’ll also hear why making a non-negotiable list isn’t about being rigid — it’s about having a tool that sharpens your discernment and keeps you close to what truly matters.


A reflection on love, clarity, and the quiet strength of knowing what you stand for. Jenna also shares some tips and tricks on how to tune in to your own intuition.


For feedback or thoughts, email Jenna at jenna.andrix@gmail.com

Host: Jenna Marilyn

Producer: JD Ferrell

Presented by: THE Modern Podcast Network and Themodern.fm

episodes.name: EP. 13 | BEING, NOT DOING
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn lets her thoughts spill raw and unfiltered — an exploration of honesty, connection, and what it means to just be.

She questions the endless strategies and advice around communication and relationships, reminding us that before we’re daters, friends, or partners, we are souls — two human beings meeting in the wild strangeness of life.

From her revillizations on adulthood (and the myth that anyone really knows what they’re doing) to her new devotion to truth as a guiding value, Jenna shares why honesty and discernment matter more than strategy. She invites you to consider: are you making choices from fear, or from love?

With humor, awe, and a little bit of chaos, this episode is a reminder to leave yourself be, to leave others be, and to bring awareness to the miracle of simply being alive.

For feedback or thoughts, email Jenna at jenna.andrix@gmail.com

episodes.name: EP. 12 | WALKING & WORDS
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn is walking and talking. She explores what it means to entangle yourself with words — and how every word you speak carries the potency of manifestation.

She reflects on meeting the challenging things in life as opportunities, the power that lives inside saying thank you, and the timeless truth: what you seek, you will find.


A moving reflection. A reminder that your words, your lens, and your seeking all shape the path beneath your feet.


For feedback or thoughts, email Jenna at jenna.andrix@gmail.com


Host: Jenna Marilyn

Producer: JD Ferrell

Presented by: THE Modern Podcast Network and Themodern.fm

episodes.name: EP. 11 | SOCIAL MEDIA
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn digs into her complex relationship with social media and the personal shifts that have led her to take a step back. After years of reflection and a few unexpected revillizations, she explores why social media feels more like an illusion of connection than a tool for true intimacy.

Jenna opens up about a conversation that shattered her perspective on the platform and how its laws don’t align with nature’s reciprocal balance. She also reflects on the primal instincts driving both men’s relationship with porn and women’s relationship with social media, unpacking the emotional charges, fleeting gratification, and the false sense of connection that keeps us hooked.

At the heart of this episode is Jenna’s revillization that reclaiming her thoughts and returning to a quieter, more intentional space is the path to true evolution. If you’ve ever wondered if social media is draining your energy or making you feel disconnected from your own desires, this one’s for you.

Jenna encourages you to reflect on the impact of social media on your well-being, your own thoughts, and your sense of authenticity. She shares her own journey of choosing silence and truth over the constant noise, and what it means to cultivate a life that truly aligns with your values.

For feedback or thoughts, email Jenna at jenna.andrix@gmail.com

Host: Jenna Marilyn

episodes.name: EP. 10 | JENNA DAY

Juggling structure, growth, and discipline, Jenna explores what happens when even sacred practices begin to feel like obligations. She speaks to the version of the listener who is doing all the “right” things, yet still feels far from themselves.

A soft meditation on burnout, overcommitment, and the ache for sunlight—this episode holds space for those longing to return to their own rhythm.

Host: Jenna Marilyn

Producer: JD Ferrell


Presented by: THE Modern Podcast Network and Themodern.fm

episodes.name: EP. 9 | SCREAM CRYING IN MY CAR
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn talks about scream crying in her car — and what it’s teaching her.

San Diego isn’t for her right now. She knows what she wants and what she stands for. That clarity feels both terrifying and freeing — but it isn’t chaos. It’s the moment you finally root down and stop falling for everything else.

Jenna shares the message the universe dropped in her lap, why messy consistency beats perfection every once in a blue moon, and what taking aligned action actually looks like (even through tears). Because following your heart? It’s not for the weak.

Discernment is everything. The whispers are worth listening to. Staying true to yourself is non-negotiable. And remember — you’re a wild thing. You don’t need to justify yourself.

If you’ve ever felt like your emotions were louder than your logic — and somehow, that’s how you knew you were on the right track — this one’s for you.

episodes.name: EP. 7 | THIS IS NOT ABOUT YOGA
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn talks about what it means to follow the whispers. She shares why she’s not doing her yoga teacher training to become a yoga teacher, even though that’s what everyone assumes. Because for her, this path isn’t about acquiring an outcome. It’s about leaning into infinite possibilities. Trusting that the next chapter doesn’t need to be named before it begins. Jenna explores the quiet magic that unfolds when you let go of needing to know, and let your heart lead instead.

She speaks on:

  • Why expectations can be limiting.
  • How it’s okay not to have a palatable answer when everyone wants clarity.
  • Why the best parts of life are often beyond your current imagination.
  • Letting go of the pressure to define your path too early.
  • The joy of choosing something simply because it feels right.
  • And following the quiet nudges — letting them unfold in their own time.

If you’re in a season of becoming, and don’t quite know what you’re becoming, this episode is your reminder:

You don’t owe anyone an explanation.

Stay open.

The possibilities are infinite.

episodes.name: EP. 6 | DISCERNMENT
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn talks about discernment — and what she’s learned after dedicating a full year to contemplating this word.

She shares how, for years, she believed she had to like and accept everyone — or else she was a bad person. For others, it’s the opposite: needing to be liked by everyone to feel worthy. Both are illusions rooted in fear — fear of rejection, of being wrong, of not trusting yourself.

You’ll hear about:

  • The difference between discernment and judgment
  • Why neutrality is a form of wisdom
  • The trap of being endlessly accepting or endlessly palatable
  • How to see clearly without attaching a story
  • How to filter through noise, advice, and influence — and find your own truth
  • Contemplative questions to help you return to your own clarity

Because you don’t have to like everything.

And not everything has to like you.

Here’s your permission slip.

episodes.name: EP. 5 | CONFIDENCE
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn talks about confidence—the kind that shows up after the leap, not before it.

Confidence, she explains, is the by-product of action, not the prerequisite. You don’t wait to feel confident and then act—you act first, and confidence tags along for the ride.

From solo flights and quitting jobs to loading a U-Haul, saying the scary good-byes, setting firm boundaries, and pressing record with shaky hands, Jenna has never felt “ready.” Every dream she’s chased arrives with fear banging on the door—and she’s learned to open it. When she steps through, panic gives way to pride, and the feeling everyone chases blooms right where fear just stood.

You’ll hear about:

Why “doing it scared” is the fastest way to gather proof and quiet doubt

How to discern when fear is a signal to grow versus a cue to pause

Real-life stories of “still-terrified” moments (and what happened next)

Building your own I-can-do-hard-things muscle, one tiny action at a time

The importance of giving yourself flowers—pausing to feel proud when you conquer a fear

If you’ve been waiting to feel confident before you leap, consider this your gentle shove:

Move first.

Meet your courage on the other side.

Watch confidence arrive right on time.

episodes.name: EP. One | CELLULAR CERTAINTY
episodes.description:
In this episode, Jenna Marilyn is talking about decisions, doubt, and the quiet certainty that lives inside your body — even when your mind is filled with fear.

In this episode, Jenna shares a moment that shifted everything: a line from The Book of Secrets by Deepak Chopra that reminded her how deeply her body knows what to do. While the mind spins in doubt, the body moves with quiet precision. It adapts. It responds. It leads — if we let it.

She opens up about her personal experience with OCD, often called “the doubting disorder,” and how indecision shaped much of her life. What helped her break free wasn’t figuring everything out — it was choosing to move, and seeing that she was supported every time.

You’ll hear about:

  • Why certainty doesn’t have to come from logic — it can come from your cells
  • The difference between mental fear and biological wisdom
  • How the universe supports you when you move with intention
  • Why you are life — and life is built to adapt
  • A redefinition of “trusting yourself” that lives deeper than thought

If you’ve ever felt stuck in fear of the “wrong” decision, or if you’ve questioned whether you can actually trust yourself — this is your reminder:

Your body already knows.

And life will meet you the moment you move.
